title: Did someone need to store their 45's?
text:
Did someone need to store their 45's?. Really? Really??

I could hardly believe how small this rack really is. I took some photos with a basic advertising pen in the photo as a size comparison.

When I looked at the rack, I told my daughter it looked like someone is trying to repurpose a warehouse full of old racks that held old 45 records! I had the same kind of rack 40 years ago.

It seems pretty sturdy, but with its size, I won't be using for cookie sheets as I had planned. Maybe baking racks or lids instead.
